vectors.name: lin-working-status-above-composer
vectors.shape: CAPTURED LIVE, and the reason the status-line region exists. A running turn draws its spinner, verb, elapsed time and token count on its own row ABOVE the composer's top rule, and the toolbar has elided 'esc to interrupt' to a bare ellipsis because 'bypass permissions on' is wider than the 'auto mode on' every earlier fixture was captured in. So the footer holds NO working marker at all, and every vector above this one would have said idle.

vectors.name: lin-main-idle-teammates-working
vectors.shape: CAPTURED LIVE. Main is idle and its teammate list sits below the toolbar: two rows read 'idle', two still carry a running 'Nm Ns · ↓ Nk tokens' run. A teammate that is not idle is this session working.
